Overview.Name: Mamatha Rachakonda
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water (no sugar)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fresh fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable upma (80 g) with mixed vegetables (50 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Poha (80 g) with peanuts (15 g) and veggies (50 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)
Option 3: 2 boiled eggs + Ragi dosa (1 small) with sambar (100 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + mixed vegetable curry (100 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2 medium) + paneer curry (120 g) + dal (100 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) with vegetables (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Roasted makhana (30 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Option 2: Sprout salad (100 g) with cucumber and tomato
Option 3: Fruit (100 g) + small handful of nuts (20 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Vegetable soup (250 ml) + 2 chapatis + lightly cooked vegetables (100 g)
Option 2: Mixed vegetable stir-fry (150 g) + ragi roti (2 small)
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) with multigrain chapati (1) + salad (50 g)

Notes_and_Tips: For thyroid: avoid very low-calorie crash diets; maintain balanced iodine and selenium through diet.
Prefer small frequent meals if you feel low energy; keep consistent meal timings.
Limit fried foods; choose steamed, grilled, or sautéed options.
Include fiber-rich foods (millets, vegetables, dals) for satiety and weight control.
Stay hydrated and aim for gentle daily movement like walking or yoga.
When socializing, prioritize your regular meal and take small portions of treats.
